sentences.text: The jackfruit -LRB- Artocarpus heterophyllus -RRB- , also known as jack tree , jakfruit , or sometimes simply jack or jak , is a species of tree in the fig , mulberry , and breadfruit family -LRB- Moraceae -RRB- .	Moraceae	Moraceae	Artocarpus	Artocarpus	tree	tree	fig	Common fig	mulberry	mulberry	breadfruit	breadfruit

It is native to parts of South and Southeast Asia and is believed to have originated in the southwestern rain forests of the Western Ghats in the Indian subcontinent .	South	South Asia	Southeast Asia	Southeast Asia	Western Ghats	Western Ghats	Indian subcontinent	Indian subcontinent
The jackfruit tree is well suited to tropical lowlands , and its fruit is the largest tree-borne fruit , reaching as much as 35 kg in weight , 90 cm in length , and 50 cm in diameter .	tree	tree
The jackfruit tree can produce about 100 to 200 fruits in a year .	tree	tree
The jackfruit is a multiple fruit , composed of hundreds to thousands of individual flowers , and it is the fleshy petals that are eaten .	multiple fruit	multiple fruit
The jackfruit tree is a widely cultivated and popular food item throughout the tropical regions of the world .	tree	tree
Jackfruit is the national fruit of Bangladesh .	national fruit	national fruit	Bangladesh	Bangladesh
